name: Makoto Koichi
bio: Makoto Koichi (小市 眞琴, Koichi Makoto, February 17) is a Japanese stage actress, voice actress, and choreographer from Tokyo. She is currently affiliated with tomorrow jam, and previously with Atomic Monkey (April 2014–April 1, 2021) and Stay Luck (April 1, 2021–December 1, 2024). She is sometimes miscredited as 小市 真琴.
